name: Analytical waste truck route proxy (not GPS)

metadata.method: Analytical waste-truck route proxy: DSNY collection-frequency-zone centroid to nearest in-city DSNY waste facility, routed on the official NYC DOT Truck Route network. This is not vehicle GPS or an observed DSNY itinerary.
